facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of P-7110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-7110 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-7110 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 24 October 2005 a near hit was recorded on P-7110 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
